title: Australia Advances to Women's T20 World Cup Final
summary: Australia defeated the West Indies in a Women's T20 World Cup semi-final, with Beth Mooney and Ashleigh Gardner leading their team to victory. The match took place at the Oval in London, England, as part of the tournament being held in England due to the COVID-19 pandemic. This win marks Australia's path to another Women's T20 World Cup final.
